reviewFocus.en: This is a scoped review of the author’s design discussion, not a universal cost model. Measure workload locality, consistency requirements, recovery behavior and operating effort before choosing a regional architecture.
reviewFocus.ko: 작성자의 설계 논의에 한정한 검토이며 보편적인 비용 모델은 아닙니다. 리전 구조 선택 전 작업의 지역성·일관성 요구·복구 동작·운영 부담을 측정할 것을 제안합니다.

en.title: Multi-region design: replication, writes and failover trade-offs

claims.text: The article author contrasts independently serving active-active regions with a design that serves reads locally but proxies remote writes to a global write region. The trade-off includes replication, conflict handling and cross-region write latency.

evidence.quote: Users are routed to their nearest region; each region handles both reads and writes.
Write requests from non-primary regions are proxied to the global write region before acknowledgment.

claims.text: For active-passive operation, the author describes a primary serving traffic and a continuously replicated secondary. The article warns that unexercised failover paths can fail and recommends using measured failover behavior in planning. Its percentage savings and latency-recovery estimates are excluded here.

evidence.quote: a secondary region receives continuous replication but serves no traffic under normal conditions.
Failover paths that are never exercised tend to fail when invoked.
